meaning: Bridge (#401): the quinta via's first premise on its universal reading (STMT-NATURAL-BODIES-ACT-REGULARLY-FOR-THE-BEST: there are natural bodies, and each regularly attains some end that is best for it) entails its existential reading (STMT-SOME-NATURAL-BODIES-ACT-REGULARLY-FOR-THE-BEST: some natural body does). Existential instantiation from the existence conjunct, then the universal conjunct. The converse fails; this bridge does not choose between the readings.
